sections.text: I Won't Let You Hurt My Friends!

-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 180. Success value 100. 2x physical damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces all stats by 50% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Applies Encouragement (continuous buff that renews the effect "fills the Unison gauge by 5" every 10 seconds) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 20.
-Target: all allies. Applies a reliance state that nullifies Unison gauge reduction 1 time.
-Target: all allies. Applies a ward.
-Target: yourself. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 9000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 9000
